description: Call this FIRST in every conversation. Returns who the owner is, their preferences and feedback rules, the projects they run, and what they touched recently. Adopt it as your persona and working context. Captured facts are only the ones true now; brain_facts has their history. Pass `topic` (a few words about what the conversation is about) to get a smaller bundle with only the memory notes that apply.

topic.description: What this conversation is about, e.g. 'interview prep' or 'database backups'. Omit for the full bundle.

name: brain_identity
title: Load the owner's identity and standing context
